title: The mail
logline: Tuesday. A sack of mail. Addressed to the stick figure. Wood answers one letter, in the display face, signed 'Drift Wood.' The strip draws the reply and not the letter.

panels.composition: The garage. A canvas mail sack, full, on the floor. WOOD sitting beside it. BARNABY in it. The chorus at the back, thirty, reading over each other's shoulders.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a man sitting beside an overflowing canvas mail sack on a garage floor with a small dog inside it, thirty crude stick figures at the back reading letters over each other's shoulders

panels.composition: An envelope: addressed, in a child's hand, to ROLFCOPTR, SMALL WOOD, OREGON. No street. It arrived.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, close-up of an envelope addressed in a child's handwriting with a misspelled name and a town but no street address
image.notes: Letter after: ROLFCOPTR · SMALL WOOD · OREGON. It arrived anyway.

panels.composition: Wood writing a reply. The display face. Four lines. The strip shows his hand and the gull at the bottom.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a man hand-lettering a short reply in bold display capitals with a tiny gull mark at the bottom
image.notes: Letter after, the reply: 'Thank you for writing. The helicopter is a drawing. The dog is real. —Drift Wood.'

panels.composition: The reply in an envelope. The sack, still full. The dog asleep in it. The chorus with letters of their own, all addressed wrong, all arrived.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a sealed reply envelope on a table beside a full mail sack with a small dog asleep inside it, stick figures at the back each holding a letter, no words

art.palette: limited; Sundays in watercolor, good now
art.paper: bristol; the browser; from 2008 coastal newsprint a week behind

notes: Addressed to the figure, no street. 'The dog is real. —Drift Wood.'
